text.p: Metropolitan Realty Company, L.L.C. said Friday effective December 6, 1996, it acquired all of the assets and liabilities of Metropolitan Realty Corporation, which has been dissolved.

The acquisition was the result of Metropolitan Realty shareholder approval of a restructuring proposal. Holders of 50,000 or more shares of the firm will receive membership interests in Metropolitan Realty Company, L.L.C.
Those shareholders with less than 50,000 shares will receive a cash payment of $9.03 per share. Metropolitan Realty had operated since 1988 as a real estate investment trust.

In connection with the restructuring, MRC, L.L.C. announced that $22.5 million of additional capital has been raised. New and existing investors include Ford Motor Co and Chrysler Corporation Master Retirement Trust.

The managing board of MRC, L.L.C. said Robert G. Jackson has been retained as president and chief executive officer of the company. Jackson recently retired as president of Ford Motor Land Development Company, a unit of Ford.
